intro.h2: A local countertop shop that does it right the first time
paragraphs: Danny's Top Shop is the place for countertop installation in Festus, MO when you want to talk to the person who will do the work. Come into the shop, pick your countertop and sink, and Danny takes it from there. One customer chose us after seeing the quality of our work at his church kitchen and school library.

Customers keep using the same words: fair prices, great workmanship, friendly people. One long-time customer says our service and products have gone unmatched for decades because Danny shares his knowledge to help you get it right the first time. Another still loves her countertop a year and a half later.

about.h2: About Danny and the Top Shop
about.text: Danny's Top Shop is a countertop and cabinet shop at 793 American Legion Dr in Festus, Missouri. Customers say it plainly: they call or go see Danny. He has served the area for decades, according to one long-time customer, and is known for sharing his knowledge, being honest and paying prompt attention to detail. Danny does the countertop work, and our office manager Sarah keeps each project moving and keeps customers informed. Our counters are in homes around Festus as well as in a church kitchen and a school library. Customers rate us 4.9 stars on Google.

service_area.text: Danny's Top Shop is at 793 American Legion Dr in Festus, MO, and our work is in kitchens around town as well as in a local church kitchen and school library. Visit the shop on weekdays to see options and talk to Danny. If you are outside Festus and want to know whether we can install at your home, call (636) 931-6606 and ask.

items.q: Can I buy a sink from you too?
items.a: Yes. One customer bought a granite sink from our shop with her countertop and says it has been the best sink she has owned. Ask about sinks when you come in, and we can install the sink and counters together as one job.

items.q: Can you help if my new appliance does not fit?
items.a: Often, yes. For one customer Danny helped put in a new stove top and oven and trimmed a cabinet so the new refrigerator would fit. Tell us the appliance size and your cabinet layout when you call, and we will say what is possible.

items.q: Do you work on churches and schools?
items.a: Yes. We have installed counters in a church kitchen and a school library. A customer who saw that work chose us for the counters and sink in their own home. Call (636) 931-6606 to talk about your building, the rooms involved and the timing you need.

Monday to Friday from 8 AM to 4 PM, with the shop closed on weekends. You can stop by 793 American Legion Dr in Festus, call (636) 931-6606 or email dannystopshop@yahoo.com with your kitchen measurements and a photo of your current counters.

One customer wrote that a year and a half after the work was done, everything still looks so good, and her new cabinet paint looks great next to the countertop Danny installed. Ask Danny which surface suits how you use your kitchen.

final_cta.text: Call or go see Danny at the shop in Festus.
